messages:
Dina: uploaded a quick pass on the trace panel micro-interactions — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/trace-telemetry-mini
Dina: TL;DR: trying a compact header for request drilldowns, push the primary CTA into the top right, reduce visual weight of correlation IDs
Alexa: I like the compact header for dense lists, but worried the CTA might compete with the search pill. Screenshot? :eyes:
Dina: added 3 variants in the file — variant A keeps CTA inline, B floats it as a sticky top-right CTA, C hides it behind kebab with an explicit label. comments on frames 2/3/4
Kevin: quick perf note — sticky actions add a bit of layout thrash on very long traces. we can debounce but wanted to flag infra cost
Sam: From product POV, users expect an explicit "Download trace" affordance. "Export" is ambiguous. Thoughts on copy: "Download snapshot" vs "Export trace"?
Marco: a11y nit: make sure the CTA has an aria-label that includes the trace id, e.g. aria-label="Download trace 12345". Also keyboard focus order needs to keep search before actions.
Alexa: copy preference: "Download snapshot" reads clearer to non-devs. but for advanced users "Export trace" is fine. maybe we show "Download snapshot" and in tooltip show "Export (HAR/JSON)" ?
Dina: proposed rule — primary visible CTA = "Download snapshot"; kebab menu -> "Export as JSON" and "Export as HAR". Tooltip on CTA: "Quick snapshot (full trace JSON)"
Kevin: technically we can wire both; note when we include full KV cache it's large. maybe the UI should show an estimated size before confirming download. small backend change
Sam: yes estimate size first. also add a small counter for the number of spans included so users know scope. e.g., "Snapshot ~ 2.3MB · 1,248 spans"
Marco: aria-live for the size estimate update? if it changes after a filter, announce summary change. Also ensure color contrast on the estimate badge (currently 3:1) needs 4.5:1 if text is small
Dina: good catch. I'll bump contrast and move estimate to larger text weight.
Alexa: micro-interaction: when export completes, use a subtle toast with a copyable link and a keyboard shortcut hint (D then S?)
Kevin: build/infra: add rate-limit on export generation and background job for big snapshots. toast link -> signed url valid 10m.
Sam: product: add a small permission check — only org members with "trace:download" role see CTA. fallback for others: show disabled state with tooltip "Request access"
Dina: mock updated: frame 5 shows tooltip state + permission modal flow. Also swapped CTA color to emerald-600 per brand guidance.
Marco: final a11y sweep request: tab order, role="dialog" on permission modal, focus trap, esc closes, and announce when download ready. I can run axe on the prototype if you want.
Dina: yes please, Marco. Can you run axe on variant B sticky CTA and share top 3 failures?
a11y-bot: Reminder: automated contrast test flagged "estimate-badge" for contrast ratio 3.0 on 1937654365. See report: https://a11y/reports/1937654365
Kevin: noted. I'll follow up on rate-limit and signed urls after standup.
Sam: OK, decision summary: primary copy "Download snapshot", tooltip + kebab for format exports, show estimated size + span count, permission gating, aria/live for dynamic updates. Dina to update mocks, Marco to run a11y sweep, Kevin to scope backend changes.
Dina: thanks all — I'll push updated frames and drop a short decision note in the design board. :raised_hands:
